name: NTUC Link (Link Rewards / Linkpoints)

scam_info.notes: Found via web search. Cloudflare challenge to curl; one WebFetch attempt also 403. Unverified (search snippet): says Link Rewards communicates with members via FairPrice Group app push notifications, emails and SMSes based on notification preferences. Specific sender IDs/emails not seen.

notes: Link Rewards programme site www.link.sg (b, 2026-11-26 HTTP 200, Next.js). Separate record because it has its own domain and a scam-related help article. blocked: support.link.sg (Zendesk) Cloudflare challenge. pass.link.sg seen as login host in FairPrice homepage HTML. Parent ntucenterprise.sg (see fairprice.com.sg notes); 'NTUC Link Pte Ltd' from LinkedIn link on link.sg footer.
